turnaround_reason: Coty collapsed to penny-stock territory (~$2.88, from $4.56) on soft beauty demand, the Gucci license loss, and a heavy debt load. The bet is that JAB-backed deleveraging, productivity savings, and SKU rationalization eventually stabilize a franchise trading below book.
bullish_points: Real deleveraging: net debt cut ~$840M to $2.9B in FY2026 with >$250M productivity savings
Q4 like-for-like sales fell only 1%, ahead of guidance, on stronger US prestige fragrance and mass cosmetics orders
Trades below book (P/B ~0.85) and at forward P/E ~11 with ~$363M FCF; strong gross margin (~63%)
Insider/sponsor alignment: JAB owns ~59%; officer von Bretten bought ~$200k at $2.41
'Color the Future' program cutting SKUs 20% to reduce returns/obsolescence and lift EBITDA over time
bearish_points: Analyst mean target (~$2.69) sits BELOW the current price — the Street sees no upside here
FY2027 is a declared transition year: Q1 LFL sales down low-to-mid single digits, adjusted EBITDA down low-10s%, and NO full-year guidance issued
Heavy leverage (debt ~$3.3B, D/E ~98, current ratio 0.755) leaves little margin for error
Gucci Beauty exit (FY2028) removes a prestige revenue stream; beauty category demand remains soft with tariff pressure
GAAP still loss-making (profit margin -10.4%, operating margin -2.4%)
catalyst: Evidence in FY2027 prints that LFL sales stabilize while debt keeps falling and the SKU/productivity programs lift EBITDA
catalyst_timing: Q1 FY2027 earnings ~Nov 5, 2026 (no FY guidance expected)
suggested_trade: Pass / watch-only for now; at most a tiny speculative spot nibble given deleveraging progress, but the setup is a falling knife with negative Street targets
key_risk: Beauty demand stays weak through the transition year so declining EBITDA outpaces debt reduction, and the leveraged equity keeps compressing
would_skip_if: LFL sales declines re-accelerate or deleveraging stalls; a below-current analyst target and no guidance argue for patience
